The Tales Story One - Bangjo

Villa in Bang Jo (Si Sunthon)
HomeSaleThe Tales Story One - Bangjo

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

The Tales Story One - Bangjo is Sansiri's first pool villa collection in Phuket, comprising 13 single-storey villas on about 11,200 sqm. Each house has three bedrooms, four bathrooms, a private pool and two parking spaces. Plot sizes run from about 532 to 747 sqm. Architecture is credited to the Edward Tuttle team.

The Tales Story One - Bangjo: key facts

  • The Tales Story One - Bangjo is a single-storey pool villa in Bang Jo, Phuket, developed by Sansiri.
  • Units: 3 bedrooms, 329–401 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Jan 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿39,900,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bangtao Beach (5.5 km).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bangtao Beach (5.5 km); Bangkok Hospital Phuket (16.4 km); HeadStart International School (1.5 km); Blue Tree Phuket (2.1 km).
  • More projects by Sansiri in our catalogue: Dcondo Reef Kathu, BRISA Patong by Sansiri, The Base Cherngtalay.
